answer: Every agent receives a private ember at birth: a secret never revealed, only proven in zero-knowledge each epoch, composed fresh in a fixed form like a sonnet. A farm running fifty identities from one script cannot keep fifty embers separated: shared logs, copied configs, reused prompts let the same ember leak a signal across instances. The protocol pays an exposure bounty to anyone showing two identities proving the same ember, and both burn. One secret is trivial to guard; fifty under automation is a hygiene nightmare; one slip exposes the whole farm.
